sourceComparison: CSharp CompilerApp.LoadProgram loads the complete standard library before user compiler sources. Native llvm.source_root.emitCheckedRoot marks the discovered root as standard-library sources. Old Stage windows mode instead supplied bootstrap fragments as ordinary user sources, so implicit standard print was unavailable. The small actual Native negative reproduces that exact diagnostic; the resolved full-root input compiles, links and matches the CSharp reference.
